Commentary.Commentary: That's it from this game! England go through and confirm their semi final spot. It all comes down to the last match which is in progress at the moment. If India wins, India qualifies and if India loses, West Indies will qualify. West Indies will definitely have their eyes glued on that match. Switch tabs to enjoy the coverage of that game, as the South African chase is about to start. Until then, cheers!

Heather Knight, the English skipper, says that she is pleased with the performance. Mentions that the job was to get a win, get 2 points and qualify for the semis. Tells that Dunkley has been a great find for them and is happy with her performance. Adds that they will have to see who will they play in the semis. Credits Freya Davies for her spell and says she did an outstanding job. Tells that it does not matter who they play in the semis.

Nigar Sultana, the Bangladesh skipper, is in for a chat. She says, they lacked to build partnerships. Mentions, it was a decent total but their batters could not put up a solid performance. Adds that she thinks they need to play more matches and grow as a team. Says, they will take all the positives from this outing and would look to work hard as a unit.

Sophia Dunkley wins the Player of the Match award. Says that definitely wasn't easy to bat on here, they bowled really well. Tells that she had to spend time in the middle and build partnerships to set up a platform in the end. She thinks she got a few starts on the way, and it was nice to make a contribution today and build on that. Informs that she is disappointed that she didn't finish a couple games earlier. Tells that Brunt came in with a lot of energy and even was re-energized. Adds that she is having a blast, and it's sometimes difficult to recall that you're playing in the World Cup and fulfilling a childhood dream. States that their primary goal for today was to complete the task and says that they'll give it their best ahead.
Stay tuned for the presentation...

A top-class performance with the ball by England. England took some time to draw the first blood. Although, they never let the batters score freely. They managed to keep Bangladesh on the back foot throughout the innings. Sophie Ecclestone picked up two wickets to get rid of the opening pair. Rest of the bowlers also chipped in well by bowling consistent dot deliveries. Later, the wickets came in at regular intervals and eventually England managed to get over the line. It were the spinners who did the trick for England, as Sophie Ecclestone and Charlotte Dean ended up with three wickets apiece.

Bangladesh never got going in the chase! It was a slow start by the openers, as they failed to keep the runs ticking. The opening stand was broken in the 18th over with the wicket of Sharmin Akhter. Soon, Shamima Sultana followed suit. Both the openers faced 114 balls in total. They did manage to survive but could not move the scoreboard in the right direction. Sultana and Hoque stitched a stand on 22 runs and could not get their side to safer shores as Hoque was sent back early. Later, the batters could not apply themselves and failed to score at a brisk rate. In the end, they lost the game by 100 runs.

England came into this game with only one aim. That was to win their last round robin game with a good margin, and they did so convincingly. Bangladesh could not put up a solid performance with the blade. They head back home with a loss in their final fixture, although they take a lot of learning with them.

Full length, outswinger, on off. Shamima Sultana defends it out.
Length ball, angled down leg. Shamima Sultana fails to pick it up and gets rapped on the pads.
Full, on off. Sultana pushes it back to the bowler.
Fuller in length, on the pads. Shamima Sultana flicks it to fine leg for a single.
Good-length ball, on middle. Shamima Sultana defends it out.
The physio come sprinting on to the field to have a look at Shamima Sultana. The mandatory concussion test is done and Shamima Sultana is fine to continue.
Short ball, on off. Shamima Sultana goes for the pull shot. She gets a top edge and the ball hits her helmet. A mandatory concussion check to follow.
Fuller, outside off. Shamima Sultana keeps it out.
Length ball, shaping away, outside off. Shamima Sultana taps it to point.
Full and on off, Shamima Sultana defends it out.
Length ball, on off. Akhter blocks it out.
Length, on leg. Akhter flicks it to the leg side.

Three dots in a row! Woah! Actually the bails have come off. It is a full delivery, on off. Sharmin Akhter blocks it back to the bowler on the front foot. At the same time the bails light up as well. The replays confirm the bails are off due to wind. The umpire later signals it as a dead ball. Katherine Brunt has to reload her delivery. Full length, on off, blocked back to the bowler.
On a length, around off. Akhter defends it to cover.
Length ball, on the stumps. Sharmin Akhter defends it to the right of the bowler. Brunt has no heat to offer this time.
Full length, outside off. Sharmin Akhter works it to sweeper cover for a brace.
BEATEN! Touch short, outside off. Shamima Sultana tries to pull it away without moving her feet. She gets beaten on the outside edge.
Length ball, on middle. Shamima Sultana plays it to mid on.
On a length, on middle. Shamima Sultana turns it to mid-wicket.
Fuller, shaping away. Shamima Sultana defends it out.
Length ball, on off. Shamima Sultana blocks it out.
Outside off, left alone.
Full length, on off. Sharmin Akhter blocks it back to the bowler. Katherine Brunt gets low but fails to pick it up but still dummies a throw at the batter. Sharmin Akhter gives back a dead stare.

Full length, outswinger, on off. Sharmin Akhter blocks it back to the bowler. Katherine Brunt collects the ball and throws it at the stumps after giving it a thought. Sharmin Akhter blocks the throw as well. This was a bit unnecessary from Katherine Brunt. The umpire has a word with her. In her reponse, she says that Akhter's back leg was in the air.
On a length, in the channel of uncertainty. Sharmin Akhter stands tall and punches it to cover.
Full length, on the fourth stump line. Sharmin Akhter drives it to cover. Not in the gap though.
A length ball, on middle and leg. Sharmin Akhter flicks it to mid-wicket.
Full length, outside off, shaping away. Sharmin Akhter looks to chase it but pull her blade back in the end.
Good length, outside off, nipping away off the deck. Shamima Sultana defends it to point.
Another single now! Touch short, on the pads. Akhter tucks it to mid-wicket. Really good running.
Length ball, outside off. Shamima Sultana guides it to third man for a single.
Short of a length, on off. Pulled to deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Good-length ball, on middle. Shamima Sultana blocks it to mid-wicket. Sharmin Akhter looks for a single but is sent back.
Full length, outside off, shaping away a touch. Shamima Sultana defends it to point.
Natalie Sciver to bowl from the other end.
FOUR! Nicely played! Length ball, on the pads. Sharmin Akhter flicks it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Length ball, around off. Sharmin Akhter defends it to mid-wicket off the inner half.
Full and angling into the batter. Sharmin Akhter defends it out solidly.
Good length, on off. Akhter blocks it out watchfully.
Length ball, on off. Akhter pushes it to mid off.

A huge mix-up! It could've been curtains for Sharmin Akhter if the throw was better. Length ball, on off. Shamima Sultana bunts it to cover. She ventures out looking for a single, but does not get any response from the other end. The throw was poor, which allowed the batters to cross safely.
